title: Long-time dynamics for time-nonlocal generalized Rayleigh-Stokes equations
summary: In this paper, we consider an autonomous semi-dynamical system driven by semilinear time-nonlocal evolution equations, these type equations are used to describe the Rayleigh-Stokes problem for a non-Newtonain fluid to a generalized second grade fluid. We first investigate the global well-posedness of solutions consisting of global Lipschitz condition by a weighted space $\mathcal C$. Utilizing the topology convergence on compact subsets of $\mathcal C$, we construct a semi-dynamical system that satisfies the semi-group structure.
